name: Contrail
tag: Guide planes onto runways, keep them apart and run a busy airport
title: Contrail

text.TAG: You are the control tower. Draw flight paths, line planes up with the right runway, and keep everyone a safe distance apart
text.FREE: Any airport you like: unlimited runways and helipads, and no crashes
text.WATCH: A tour of busy skies: regional strips, a giant hub and island hoppers
text.FOOT: Small planes land on short runways, jets and jumbos on long ones, helicopters on helipads. Two planes too close together is a crash.
text.FIND: Find a flight, runway or tool…
text.HINT: Drag from a plane to draw its path · right-drag to look around
